title: Substantia Nigra Susceptibility-To-Volume Ratio Derived From QSM as a Marker for Discrimination of Progressive Supranuclear Palsy From Parkinson's Disease and Multiple System Atrophy
journal: J Magn Reson Imaging · Candan HE 等
tag: 影像生物標記 · 鑑別診斷
note: → 以定量磁化率造影（QSM）計算黑質磁化率／體積比，作為 PSP 與 PD、MSA 鑑別的影像指標。

en.journal: J Magn Reson Imaging · Candan HE et al.
en.note: → Uses the substantia nigra susceptibility-to-volume ratio from QSM as an imaging marker to separate PSP from Parkinson's disease and MSA.

title: Involuntary inspiratory sigh in multiple system atrophy: A clinical and cerebral blood flow study
journal: J Neurol Sci · Nakagawa Y 等
note: → 探討 MSA 患者不隨意吸氣性歎息的臨床特徵與腦血流關聯，補充呼吸相關症狀的病生理描述。

en.journal: J Neurol Sci · Nakagawa Y et al.
en.note: → Examines the clinical features of involuntary inspiratory sighing in MSA and its relation to cerebral blood flow, adding to the pathophysiology of respiratory symptoms.

title: Mechanism-Based Therapy With Ampreloxetine for Neurogenic Orthostatic Hypotension in Multiple System Atrophy: A Randomized Withdrawal Trial
note: → 73 名 MSA 合併神經性姿勢性低血壓者的隨機停藥試驗；主要終點未達，次要分析顯示停藥者惡化、續用者維持功能（Class III）。

en.note: → Randomised withdrawal trial in 73 MSA patients with neurogenic orthostatic hypotension; primary endpoints missed, with secondary analysis showing withdrawal worsened function while continued treatment maintained it (Class III).

title: Plasma Total and Phosphorylated alpha-Synuclein as Biomarkers in Multiple System Atrophy: A Multicenter Study
note: → 多中心研究血漿總量與磷酸化 α-synuclein 作為 MSA 生物標記——關乎未來試驗能否用血液指標追療效。

en.journal: Curr Neuropharmacol · Yuan X et al.
en.note: → A multicentre study of plasma total and phosphorylated alpha-synuclein as MSA biomarkers — relevant to whether future trials can track effect with a blood measure.

en.journal: Mov Disord · Millar Vernetti P et al.
